Ezreal

the Prodigal Explorer

Ezreal is a skill-shot marksman who deals most of his damage with abilities instead of basic attacks. His blink makes him safe, and he pokes from long range. He's hard to master because you have to land Mystic Shot over and over, but he's one of the safest marksmen when played well.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Ezreal

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. His blink and long-range poke let him survive almost any lane.

Pick into

  • Teams with lots of dive: Arcane Shift keeps him safe
  • Lanes where he can poke safely, like into Caitlyn or Corki
  • Long games where he scales with items

Avoid into

  • Wind Wall champions who block his skill shots, like Yasuo
  • All-in lanes with hard crowd control that catch him
  • Teams that need high damage from their ADC

Great teammates

LeonaLeona's engage helps Ezreal land his skill shots.
SennaSenna adds long-range damage.
NamiNami's crowd control helps him hit skill shots.

Your team needs: Pick Ezreal when your team has other damage, so his safety and poke matter more than his raw output.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Arcane Shift is a short blink on a low cooldown, making him very safe
  • Long-range poke with Mystic Shot
  • Can play safely from a distance even when behind
  • Trueshot Barrage is a global ultimate for finishing enemies and clearing waves

Weaknesses

  • Lower damage than most marksmen, especially early (one of the lowest win rates this patch)
  • Needs to land skill shots; missing Q means doing almost no damage
  • Mana hungry early before Manamune
  • Struggles against all-in lanes with hard crowd control

Power spikes

  • Level 1-3: Poke with Q, but avoid fights against strong all-in lanes
  • First item (Trinity Force): your Q procs Spellblade, a big damage jump
  • Two items (Manamune): mana problems are gone and damage grows
  • Three items (Spear of Shojin): low cooldowns let you spam Q in fights

Top tips

  • Land Q to reduce all your cooldowns
  • Use W then Q for a strong poke combo
  • Save E for escaping, not chasing
  • Fire your ultimate at groups for big damage
  • Stand behind your minions so enemy skill shots hit them instead of you
  • Be patient: Ezreal is strongest with two or three items
